description: React component for viewing and managing chat messages within a dialog, including features like message export, delete, source document viewing, and artifact rendering.

classes.name: ConfirmDeleteMessageDialog
classes.description: Dialog component for confirming message deletion, with optional hard delete.

classes.name: ViewMessagesDialog
classes.description: Main dialog component for viewing, filtering, exporting, and managing chat messages.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles confirmation of message deletion, passing hardDelete flag.

methods.name: deleteMessages
methods.description: Performs deletion of chat messages, with optional hard delete, and refreshes message list.

methods.name: getChatType
methods.description: Returns user-friendly chat type label based on internal type.

methods.name: exportMessages
methods.description: Exports chat messages to a JSON file and triggers download.

methods.name: clearChat
methods.description: Confirms and clears chat session or messages.

methods.name: getChatMessages
methods.description: Processes raw chat message data into displayable format, handling timestamps and file URLs.

methods.name: getChatPK
methods.description: Generates a unique key for chat message grouping based on chatId, memoryType, sessionId.

methods.name: transformChatPKToParams
methods.description: Converts chatPK string back into request parameters.

methods.name: processChatLogs
methods.description: Deduplicates and sorts chat logs, combining user and bot messages.

methods.name: handleItemClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking on a message to load detailed view.

methods.name: onURLClick
methods.description: Opens a URL in a new tab.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a file annotation via API.

methods.name: renderFileUploads
methods.description: Renders file upload previews based on mime type.

methods.name: agentReasoningArtifacts
methods.description: Processes artifacts for agent reasoning, updating file URLs.

methods.name: renderArtifacts
methods.description: Renders artifacts as images, HTML, or markdown.
